description: Hire'in SOP training catalog seed data. Import training modules and associate with SOP records by sopCode.

trainingModules.sopTitle: Hire’in Values, Operating Standards & SOP Rollout Foundation
trainingModules.moduleTitle: Hire’in Values, Operating Standards & Why SOPs Matter
trainingModules.modality: CEO/Leadership kickoff + recorded micro-training + acknowledgment
trainingModules.purpose: Explain why Hire’in is strengthening processes, what values guide the company, and how SOPs protect candidates, clients, employees, and the business.
learningObjectives: Explain Hire’in’s core values and operating standards.
Understand why SOPs are being launched in waves and how they help reduce staffing communication chaos.
Commit to using approved systems, documentation, and escalation paths.
trainingModules.practicalExercise: Team discussion: identify one process gap, one communication gap, and one tool/adoption improvement.
trainingModules.passingCriteria: Attended/recording completed + acknowledgment submitted
trainingModules.renewalCycle: Annual or major operating model change
trainingModules.expectedBehavior: Team understands SOPs are business operating standards, not paperwork
trainingModules.replitAssociationRule: Display as global required training on the Training Dashboard and as prerequisite for all SOP-specific trainings.

trainingModules.sopTitle: Manager Certification for SOP Coaching, Adoption & Audit
trainingModules.moduleTitle: Manager Certification: Turning SOPs into Team Behavior
trainingModules.modality: Manager workshop + live case practice + certification checklist
trainingModules.purpose: Certify managers to train teams, coach behavior, audit adoption, and prevent SOPs from becoming unused documents.
learningObjectives: Run a short SOP training session using the role-based template.
Audit team behavior against SOP checkpoints and document findings.
Coach gaps using scorecards, not opinions.
trainingModules.practicalExercise: Manager completes one mock audit and one coaching note from a scenario.
trainingModules.assessment: Manager certification checklist + audit sample + coaching sample
trainingModules.passingCriteria: Trainer/CEO approval of checklist and sample artifacts
trainingModules.renewalCycle: Every 6 months
trainingModules.expectedBehavior: Managers actively drive adoption instead of forwarding documents
trainingModules.replitAssociationRule: Display as manager-only prerequisite under AUDIT-001, HR-001, and TPL-001.

trainingModules.modality: Live micro-training + job aid + scenario practice + quiz

learningObjectives: Explain the purpose and business value of HIS-SOP-GOV-001.
Apply the SOP steps in the actual Hire’in workflow using approved systems.
Identify risks, exceptions, documentation requirements, and escalation paths.
trainingModules.practicalExercise: Submit SOP version 1.1 change request
trainingModules.passingCriteria: 80% quiz score + completed scenario/checklist + digital acknowledgment
trainingModules.renewalCycle: Annual, plus when SOP version changes materially
trainingModules.expectedBehavior: SOP versioning and approval lifecycle followed
